claims.claim: The fix only touches that new test file.
claims.evidence: The diff is cumulative, so the fix commit can't be isolated. Nothing else in the diff refers to steerTo/driveToward. The CarView/PickupInstance type imports were kept, but they are still used (lines 466-467), so keeping them is correct.
